The Borrower must meet two financial covenants under the Facility Agreement. First, the Borrower must ensure its leverage (total net debt to EBITDA) does not exceed 3.0:1 on each test date [1]. Second, the Borrower must ensure its interest cover is at least 4.0:1 on each test date [1].

A breach of these covenants constitutes an event of default. Specifically, a breach of clause 19 is an event of default [1]. Upon an event of default, the Lender may cancel the facility and declare all loans immediately due [1].

A breach of these covenants constitutes an event of default.
